errors.text: The proposed Al addition and B2 phase do not reconstruct the target intervention of 4.2 at.% Cr producing approximately 4 vol.% reticulated Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.
The claimed formation of a reticulated B2 network in Al-modified Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr is not supported by the cited evidence.
The experiment lacks a phase-free Al-containing control or matched microstructures needed to cleanly separate solid-solution hardening from the secondary-phase network mechanism.
